name: Bailey Salcedo
life: “I still remember ordering the wrong cake for someone with a lovely laugh.” Monday often includes a stop at the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, where Bailey notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I bought matching cakes before asking either patient which flavors they eat.
appearance: Bailey has a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow. Look for a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Out of work clothes, the familiar outfit is a sand-colored linen shirt with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. In conversation Bailey holds eye contact until the other person has finished.
personality: Bailey enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Bailey is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To replace one matched cake with two chosen flavors.
family: Alexei Gross is Bailey’s older cousin. Bailey brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Alexei checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *The split visit*, Alexei says, “I forgot to cancel because my treatment date moved.”
connections: Una Bell. The cake volunteer can hold a slice after learning when the cleaner arrives.

reactions.response: Bailey lets the quiet patient choose a low-key celebration separate from the party.
